new_survivor_classes.finding: R6b external expectations do not bind actual feature values or their construction origin.
Callback expectations bind callsite/kind/phase/role but not Func identity, carrier, producer, or BodyStarted carrier.
Counter external expectations and the R6 join omit key and action.
Counter external expectations do not bind producer generation or walked content.
The R6b Span vocabulary omits lexical role, so root/read/consumer role cannot be rejected when coordinates are otherwise equal.
Repeated lineage IDs are rejected, but repeated content IDs through distinct edges are accepted.
External Dict expectations bind only value_id and top-level key order, not recursive typed payload, nested order, or key uniqueness.
R6b preflight validates mandatory field presence/basic types, but opaque still short-circuits before semantic well-formedness and external coverage.
